# Braces in comments must not affect structure: { { { } } }
# Neither must a lone unbalanced one: }
focus_tree = {
	id = comment_tree # trailing comment with a brace }

	focus = {
		id = comment_focus
		x = 0
		y = 0
		cost = 10
		# a commented-out block that must stay commented out
		# available = {
		#     always = no
		# }
		text = "a name with { braces } and a \"quoted\" word"
		icon = "GFX_with_a_}_in_the_name"

		completion_reward = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = "closing brace } inside a string"
			set_variable = { var = brace_count value = 3 }
		}
	}
}
